lines: Fire! The dream engraved in my heart, leaving even the future behind
I know no limits — meaningless!
This power scatters light, and beyond it lies a distant longing
If all I can do is look back on the road I've walked
Then here and now I can destroy everything
The cityscape falls into darkness — how far can people stand and fight?
From this accelerating pain, I can surely protect someone
Looking!
The blitz loop this planet to search way.
Only my RAILGUN can shoot it — right now
Through my whole body, at the speed of light
It raced — a certain premonition
Seize it! If it's what I want, leave nothing behind — shine as my true self
I believe in the vow I made that day
The tears shining in these eyes — even they will become my strength
When I stop, there's a slight ache I feel
I won't lie and say I'm never lost by it
The coin tossed in the air traces an arc that decides my fate
The answer I sent out races through my chest again today
Sparkling!
The shiny lights awake true desire.
Only my RAILGUN can shoot it. Without fail
I'll pierce straight through, without hesitation
Even wounded, I'll keep on running
Take aim! My gaze, clear and brilliant, cuts through the darkness without missing
Doubts — I just have to blow them away
As long as this heart keeps shouting, I won't let anyone stand in my way
Countless wishes dance, fleeting and fragile
Piling up in these two hands
In the darkness I tear apart, what comes into view
Are heavy, deep, aching memories
Fading, swaying in reality
I refuse to lose to despair
That I am now who I am
Head held high, I can be proud of it all!
Looking!
The blitz loop this planet to search way.
Only my RAILGUN can shoot it. Right now
Through my whole body, at the speed of light
It raced — a certain premonition
Fire! The dream engraved in my heart, leaving even the future behind
I know no limits — meaningless!
This power scatters light, and beyond it lies a distant longing
